description: Evrencik Wind Power Plant Data is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Serdal Atiç. "This dataset contains 10-minute average measurements from a wind power plant located in the Evrencik region of Bursa province, Turkey. The data includes parameters such as wind speed (m\/s), wind direction (\u00b0), air temperature (\u00b0C), and active power generation (kW). Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
